info.title: Trading Journal API
info.description: Read strategies, journal entries, trades and daily P&L / trade stats, and append notes to a journal entry. Authenticated with a per-user API key (generate one under Settings). All endpoints require the key; there is no anonymous access. Content (strategy descriptions, journal notes) is markdown; embedded images are exposed as /api/v1/attachments/{id} URLs you fetch with the same key. Keys are full-access to their user's data and come in two kinds: an agent key (Generate key under Settings) writes additively only - create entries, append notes, never edit or delete; a device key (a paired phone, POST /pair) may also edit and delete journal entries, keep balance anchors, change settings and register for push; routes marked device key answer 403 to an agent key. Poll /version, or hold GET /events open, to learn when the user's data changed.

bearerApiKey.description: Authorization: Bearer tj_... (the API also accepts the key in an X-API-Key header at runtime, but the spec advertises one scheme since ChatGPT supports only one).

AnalyticsSummary.description: Everything /analytics shows for the same filter. Money is in the account currency; R values are multiples of the trade's planned risk.

profitFactor.description: sum of wins / sum of losses; null without losses

plannedTrades.description: trades carrying a planned risk; the other fields are meaningless when 0

excursion.description: Price path while open (MAE / MFE from cached bars) over the measured trades; the other fields mean nothing when trades is 0.

exitEfficiency.description: total gross P&L / total MFE: the share of the profit on the table the exits kept

winnersAvgMae.description: heat a winning trade sat through, on average

losersAvgMfe.description: profit a losing trade had before it turned, on average

maxDrawdown.description: deepest peak-to-trough fall of cumulative net P&L, positive magnitude

maxDrawdownRecoverAt.description: null while the fall is still open

compliance.description: playbook checklist compliance per strategy, over trades whose note carries a strategy with a checklist

breakdowns.description: bySymbol, byDirection, byStrategy, byTag, byMistake, byEmotion, byDayOfWeek, byHour. A trade with several labels counts in every matching byMistake / byEmotion bucket; (none logged) is the unlabelled rest. Labels reach a trade from its own entry, a group entry it is in, or the day entry of the day it closed.

body.description: Full description (markdown); image refs rewritten to API URLs.

date.description: Trading day in the trading timezone; a trade belongs to the day of its exit.

winRate.description: wins/(wins+losses); null when no decided trades.

largestWin.description: null when no winning trade that day.

largestLoss.description: Negative; null when no losing trade that day.

from.description: Effective range start (echoed even when defaulted).

timezone.description: The trading timezone every date is in.

items.description: One per day WITH closed trades, ascending; gap days omitted.

v.description: Opaque per-user data version. Compare for inequality only (process-local; resets on restart).

bias.description: neutral = both ways, flat = stay out

maxTrades.description: decisions; a copy set counts once

stopTime.description: HH:MM trading timezone; empty for none

checks.description: empty until the day has trades

writtenLate.description: the plan was saved after the day's first entry

editedLate.description: the plan was changed after the day's first entry

baseline.description: the trader's own norms from the preceding weeks; the norm-based checks need 5 trading days

usualLastEntry.description: HH:MM trading timezone, 90th percentile of entry times

plan.description: the day's pre-market plan against the day; absent without one

label.description: the review label the finding suggests

Labels.description: Review labels from the fixed vocabulary. mistakes: chased, early-exit, late-exit, oversized, no-stop, moved-stop, held-loser, revenge, fomo, hesitated, overtraded, against-plan. emotions: calm, focused, confident, anxious, greedy, frustrated, bored, tilted, rushed.

notes.description: Markdown; image refs rewritten to API URLs.

checklist.description: The entry's strategy playbook checklist with the trader's ticks; null without a strategy or when the strategy has no checklist.

strategy.description: Assigned strategy, short name only (not the full description).

chart.description: Chart data: OHLC bars + entry/exit markers per contract panel.

chartPng.description: URL of the rendered chart image.

suggestions.description: The AI review's open suggestions (see POST /journal/{id}/suggestions)

qty.description: Qty of this fill attributed to the trade.

grossPnl.description: null for stub instruments awaiting tick setup.

plannedStop.description: The planned stop price recorded on the trade sheet; null without a plan.

plannedRisk.description: Money at risk per the plan (account currency), derived from the stop via the instrument tick value or typed directly.

r.description: R multiple: netPnl / plannedRisk. null without a plan.

mae.description: Maximum adverse excursion in money: the most the trade was under water from its average entry. null until measured from cached bars.

mfe.description: Maximum favourable excursion in money: the best the trade ever looked.

exitEfficiency.description: Realized move over MFE: 1 = out at the best price, negative = had profit and closed red. null without MFE.

excursionBars.description: Bar size the excursion was read from (1m, 5m, 1h, 1d).

setId.description: Copy set: copies of one decision across accounts share a setId. null for a decision of its own. Ids change when trades are rebuilt.

setSize.description: Members of the set (0 when not in one).

retired.description: Trade is on a retired account.

groupCount.description: Number of group entries that include this trade.

plannedStop.description: The planned stop price recorded on the trade sheet; null without a plan.

plannedRisk.description: Money at risk per the plan (account currency), derived from the stop via the instrument tick value or typed directly.

r.description: R multiple: netPnl / plannedRisk. null without a plan.

mae.description: Maximum adverse excursion in money: the most the trade was under water from its average entry. null until measured from cached bars.

mfe.description: Maximum favourable excursion in money: the best the trade ever looked.

exitEfficiency.description: Realized move over MFE: 1 = out at the best price, negative = had profit and closed red. null without MFE.

excursionBars.description: Bar size the excursion was read from (1m, 5m, 1h, 1d).

setId.description: Copy set: copies of one decision across accounts share a setId. null for a decision of its own. Ids change when trades are rebuilt.

setSize.description: Members of the set (0 when not in one).

chart.description: Cached OHLC bars + entry/exit markers per contract panel.

JournalCreate.description: Create body. The required scope-specific field depends on scope: day->date, week->week, trade->tradeId, group->tradeIds.

body.description: Markdown. Required for day/week/trade; optional for group.

planSource.description: trader | api | ai | set (inherited from the copied decision); absent without a plan

setLegs.description: account ids of the other legs of the same copied decision

stale.description: opened more than three days ago: carried, or fills are missing

stop.description: stop price; alone, the risk follows at the position's size

risk.description: money at risk; alone, the stop follows (snapped to tick)

allLegs.description: on a leg of a copied decision, write the plan on every leg (default true)

code.description: The pairing code from Settings > Phone app, e.g. AB7Q-K2MN (case, spaces and the dash do not matter)

deviceName.description: The phone's name, shown in Settings

autoPlan.description: What a new open position gets: 0 nothing, 1 the AI suggestion on its sheet, 2 the suggestion written into the plan

key.description: The device key (tj_...), shown once; store it securely

SettingsInput.description: Present fields change, absent ones are kept.

JournalUpdate.description: The whole entry as the page editors save it: absent tag, strategy, labels and checks clear them.

checks.description: Ticked checklist item ids (trade and group entries)

updatedAt.description: The entry's updatedAt as loaded; a differing value answers 409 stale with the current entry

markdown.description: The image line to put in a body

AccountBalance.description: The running balance: the latest anchor at or before today plus the net of the trades closed after it.

href.description: The web page it leads to

route.description: The app route it leads to: today, day/<date>, trade/<id>, position/<account>/<symbol>

Today.description: The day in one object; see API.md 'Today'.

DevicePrefs.description: The phone's notification settings, sent whole. Kinds: nudge, tradeClosed, planMissing (opt-in).

sandbox.description: true for a Debug (Xcode) build, whose tokens belong to Apple's sandbox service

Suggestion.description: One open proposal of the in-app AI review: the tag, the strategy, or a label.

value.description: The tag word, the strategy id, or the label key

name.description: What to show: the strategy's or the label's name

get.summary: Daily P&L + trade stats per trading day with range totals - the Calendar's numbers (daily_stats cache; retired accounts never count, excluded-from-stats accounts are dropped unless filtered).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day, inclusive, trading timezone: YYYY-MM-DD or the keyword today|yesterday|last (resolved server-side - never compute the date yourself). Default: to minus 29 days.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day, inclusive: YYYY-MM-DD or today|yesterday|last. Default: today. Span at most 400 days.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Shorthand for from=to=day. Use day=today for the intraday check.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Repeatable: acc:<id> or type:<slug> (live|prop_live|prop_funded|prop_eval|paper). An explicit filter overrides excluded_from_stats.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Legacy alias for filter=acc:<id>.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Pull the latest fills from the brokers first and wait for them (up to ~15s) before computing. Use for intraday today questions.

200.description: OK (an empty range is a 200 with items: [] and zeroed totals)

400.description: Malformed date, to before from, or span over 400 days

get.summary: The /analytics page for a date range as one object: totals, R (over planned trades), drawdown, streaks, and breakdowns by symbol, direction, strategy, tag, weekday and entry hour. Same parameters and account rules as /stats/daily; default range = last 30 days.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day, inclusive, trading timezone: YYYY-MM-DD or today|yesterday|last.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day, inclusive: YYYY-MM-DD or today|yesterday|last.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Shorthand for from=to=day.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Repeatable: acc:<id> or type:<slug>. An explicit filter lifts the excluded-from-stats rule.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Pull the latest fills from the brokers first and wait for them (up to ~15s).

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: What one count means: trades (default), or sets, where a copy set counts once with its money summed.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: confirmed: count only tags, strategies and labels the trader set or confirmed in the app, leaving out values written through the API or MCP and never saved in an editor.

400.description: Malformed date, to before from, or span over 400 days

get.summary: Per-user data version for change detection: poll it and refetch when the value differs from the last one you saw.
List the caller's strategies (name + full markdown + image URLs).
Strategy detail.
List journal entries (summary rows).

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Repeatable.

parameters.name: strategy
parameters.description: Strategy id, or 'none'.

parameters.name: mistake
parameters.description: Repeatable. Mistake label key (see Labels), or 'none' for entries with no mistake logged.

parameters.name: emotion
parameters.description: Repeatable. Emotion label key (see Labels).

post.summary: Create a journal entry (day/week/trade/group). Day/week/trade are singletons -> 409 if one already exists (use the notes endpoint to append); group always creates.

201.description: Created (returns the entry in the GET /journal/{id} shape; Location header set)

400.description: Validation error (missing/invalid field for the scope)

409.description: An entry already exists for this date/week/trade

post.summary: Prepare a day for review: cluster copytrader fan-out into group entries and solos into trade entries, create the missing ones (idempotent), and return them to analyze (by entryId). Defaults to the last trading day before today.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default = last trading day before today.

checks.description: The day's coach checks (see GET /coach); absent when they could not run.

get.summary: Journal entry detail (notes, tag, mood, strategy short name, trades overview + list, chart data, attachments).

put.summary: Replace the entry (device key only): body, tag, mood, strategy, labels, checklist

409.description: review-pending (an AI review is writing the note) or stale (it changed since you loaded it; the current entry is included)
An AI review is writing the note

post.summary: Append a dated note to the entry's body. Append-only: existing content is never removed.

note.description: Markdown; appended under a dated heading.

404.description: Entry not found (the API does not create entries)

post.summary: Assign a strategy to the entry, but only if it has none yet - an existing assignment is never changed (assigned=false then).
Set the entry's tag (good|neutral|bad), but only if it has none yet - an existing tag is never changed (assigned=false then).
Add mistake and/or emotion labels to the entry. Additive: existing labels are kept, duplicates ignored; only the UI removes labels. Keys must come from the fixed vocabulary (see Labels).

200.description: The entry's labels after the add

400.description: Unknown label key or empty body

get.summary: Rule-based coach checks for a trading day: re-entry within a minute of a loss, size up after a loss, heat past the planned stop, a winner that kept under a quarter of its best move, a loser held several times a usual winner, more decisions than the trader's usual day, entries past the usual hour. Observations with numbers, trade ids and suggested labels; not verdicts.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Trading day: YYYY-MM-DD or today|yesterday|last; default = the last trading day.

get.summary: The weekly edge digest for an ISO week, counted per decision (a copy set once, money summed): headline numbers against the week before, keep and fix sentences derived from the numbers, best and worst decision, the coach's findings tallied across the days, how the day plans held, the week's AI review lessons, and the week's analytics summary.

parameters.name: week
parameters.description: YYYY-Www; default the week of the last trading day.

lessons.description: The week's AI review lessons, grouped by the mistake they are about.

get.summary: The trader's pre-market plan for a day and how the day measured against it (one check per rule, held or not).

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD or today|yesterday|last; default today.

post.summary: Write or amend the plan for today or a future day. Present fields replace the stored ones (an empty string or 0 clears), absent fields are kept; a plan left empty is removed. Past days are refused: their record is edited in the app, where a late edit is flagged.

200.description: The stored plan (null when it ended up empty)

get.summary: Server-rendered candlestick PNG of the entry's chart (cached data only).

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: Pick a contract/root when the entry spans several; defaults to the first.

get.summary: Fetch an embedded image referenced by a strategy/journal body the caller owns.

List closed trades (filtered, paged; page size 50). Retired accounts and accounts hidden in Settings (excluded_from_stats) are left out by default; an explicit account_id / filter overrides the visibility rule, show_retired the retired one.

parameters.name: symbol_root
parameters.description: e.g. MES

parameters.name: risk
parameters.description: planned: trades carrying a stop or risk; past-stop: planned trades whose measured heat (mae) exceeded plannedRisk.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on the exit day (trading timezone): YYYY-MM-DD or today|yesterday|last (resolved server-side).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound: YYYY-MM-DD or today|yesterday|last. For today's trades send from=today&to=today.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Pull the latest fills from the brokers first and wait for them (up to ~15s) before listing.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the list; default newest entry first

get.summary: Trade detail: fills, linked journal entry id, group count, and cached chart data.
Server-rendered candlestick PNG of the trade's chart (cached data only).

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: Pick a contract/root; defaults to the first with data.

get.summary: The caller's open positions right now, each with the plan recorded on it. Not trades yet: a position becomes a trade, carrying its plan, when it closes.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: pull the latest broker fills first and wait for them (~15 s max)

post.summary: Record the plan on an open position (source api: shown as set through the API until the trader saves it). The whole plan is replaced; an empty body clears it.

409.description: No open position on this account and contract

post.summary: Exchange a one-time pairing code (Settings > Phone app) for a device key. No key needed; throttled per address.

201.description: The device key, the server and the user

429.description: Too many failed attempts from this address; see Retry-After

get.summary: The key's user, the server (version, timezone, features) and the user's settings

put.summary: Change the user's switches (device key only): guardrail, automatic plans

post.summary: Upload an image (device key only; multipart field 'file', PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP, 8 MiB)

415.description: Not an image type we store

get.summary: The mistake and emotion vocabulary with display names
Accounts with their running balance and today's net

post.summary: Record the account's balance on a day (device key only)

delete.summary: Remove a balance anchor (device key only)

404.description: Not your account, or not its anchor

get.summary: Equity now by account type, the per-day curve, the drawdown over the closed trades, today's change

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: acc:N or type:slug, repeatable

get.summary: The day in one object: stats, open positions and unrealised P&L, the plan and how much of it is used, nudges, the curve, equity

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Pull the latest broker fills first

get.summary: Server-sent events (text/event-stream): 'version' events with {"v":N} after every change of your data, a ': ping' comment every 25 s
A day's guardrail nudges, newest first, with the unseen count

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD or today|yesterday|last; default today

post.summary: Mark a nudge seen (the trader acknowledged it)

get.summary: The phones registered for push (device key only)

post.summary: Register a phone's push token with its settings (device key only); a known token is updated

put.summary: Replace a phone's notification settings (device key only)
Report the push-to-start token and the running Live Activities, whole (device key only)

post.summary: Accept or dismiss one of the AI review's suggestions on the entry (device key only). Accept makes it the field, as the trader's own; dismiss keeps it dismissed so a later review does not propose it again.

200.description: The entry after the change, as GET /journal/{id} returns it

400.description: do must be accept or dismiss, or an invalid value

409.description: An AI review is writing the note (reason review-pending)
